name: Logger
reason: VectorCore.Logger versus os.Logger, which has existed since macOS 11, so this is pre-existing and not a toolchain regression. VectorCore itself compiles because module-local declarations shadow imports; only downstream files importing both modules must disambiguate the name. Allowlisted per root ruling 2026-10-03 (T01 brief-addendum item 2) and retained by D02 (RD-R5): a rename would be a downstream source migration (D01, user-deferred). Clients can qualify VectorCore.Logger and os.Logger with both modules imported, as exercised by Scripts/ci/tests/D02/LoggerModuleQualification.swift. The scoped import (`import struct VectorCore.Logger`) also works, as exercised by Scripts/ci/tests/D02/LoggerQualification.swift. Matching is keyed on (name, SDK module), so this one entry also covers the re-export VectorCoreBenchmarking.Logger.
